Reported per arm, paired by start against neither, and shipped against noscum and nobfs (each part's own effect): deaths, deaths at CL <= 2 and while max HP < 25; CL at 25k, 50k and 100k turns (milestones); starts reaching DL3 and DL5 with their first turn there (first_turn_at_depth); identical plays; the "# Stair scum:" level changes and returns per game. Descriptive at this size; the next tier (verysmall, starts 1-45) only after the gate is checked and the owner agrees, with the arms the owner keeps.
